"''There are some names I don't even know!|Maarva and Cassian Andor|audio=Maarva-Cassian-CassiansWomen.flac|}} '''Karla''' was an individual whom [[Maarva Carassi Andor|Maarva Andor]], adoptive [[Parent|mother]] of the [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], considered to be one of "Cassian's women." In [[5 BBY]],{{AndorDate|102}} Maarva and Cassian discussed who knew that Cassian's real [[homeworld]] was [[Kenari]] while in their [[Andor household|home]] on the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]]. During the conversation, Maarva worried that Cassian might have told some of his women, listing Karla, [[Femmi]], [[Sondreen]], and mentioning that there were others whose names she did not know. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|When you get into it, she can say "well it can be any one of your women" so she starts listing all these women, so you realize oh my god he's sleeping around all the time, he's got all these women, she disapproves of it and he's just, there's another nail in the, in the Cassian failure story here.|Tony Gilroy|{{YouTube|video=X13nYZNTLYM|text=Andor Q&A - Tony Gilroy - (S1 eps 1-4 )|channel=backstorymagazine2757|name=Backstory Magazine|date=2022-09-29}}}} Karla was mentioned in "[[That Would Be Me]]," the second episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which aired on [[September 21]], [[2022]].{{SWYouTube|cKOegEuCcfw|Andor | Official Trailer | Disney+ (2:25)|sw_url=video/andor-official-trailer}} When talking about "Cassian's women," writer [[Tony Gilroy]] has suggested that the list of names shows the audience that Andor has been sleeping around and that his mother disapproves of it, adding to the idea that Cassian is a failure at the start of the series. ==Appearances== *{{Andor|That Would Be Me}} {{1stm}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Karla |ka=კარლა |nl=Karla |pl=Karla}} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified species]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
